FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Pinnacle General Contractors, we pride ourselves on delivering high-quality construction services, specializing in residential new home construction and interior renovations. Our operations are primarily focused within the state of Illinois, ensuring compliance with local regulations and minimizing jurisdictional risks. We work on projects with an emphasis on single-family homes, performing non-structural modifications such as kitchen and bathroom remodels. Our dedicated team utilizes licensed subcontractors for specialized trades like electrical, plumbing, and HVAC work, all of whom are required to provide Certificates of Insurance to mitigate liability risks. With an annual gross receipt under $2 million, we maintain a careful approach to managing our operations, ensuring strong safety protocols and consistent risk management practices. Our commitment to excellence is highlighted by a clean regulatory record and proactive safety measures that minimize potential claims.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Pinnacle Renovations LLC, 4567 Oak Avenue, Springfield, IL 62704-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a minor water leak was discovered during a routine inspection at a residential renovation site, resulting in damage to the drywall in the bathroom area. The cost of repairs was estimated at $2,000. The claim was successfully closed, and all repairs were completed by the end of the month.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
